# Rule 8 — Job and department expectations
Play your assigned job in a reasonable way. You are expected to understand your department’s basic responsibilities and to make a good-faith effort to perform them.
Do not abandon important roles without a valid reason. Command, security, engineering, medical, science, cargo, and other critical staff should not ignore their duties to wander off or cause unrelated chaos.
You may roleplay mistakes, personality flaws, laziness, corruption, or conflict, but it should still create believable roleplay and not simply sabotage your department or the round.
Department authority should be respected in-character. Heads of staff and command may give lawful orders related to their department, but they should use their position responsibly and support roleplay.
Security, command, and other high-impact roles are held to a higher standard because their actions can strongly affect the round.
